Custom Screen Printing for Florence & the Fremont County Area

Florence is a small Fremont County city of about 3,800 residents — historic downtown, oil heritage, and a quiet character that reflects the broader Fremont County corridor west of Cañon City. The area's largest employers are the correctional facilities that dot Fremont County, alongside healthcare, agriculture, and the small businesses serving this rural working-class community. Custom workwear, company event shirts, and team uniforms are practical orders for the employers and sports programs here.

Florence schools are part of the Fremont RE-2 District, which also serves Penrose. Florence Junior/Senior High School is the main program in town, with youth sports and school events that generate demand for custom gear. Many Florence residents also commute to Cañon City for work, linking both communities economically. We're about 50 miles northeast in Colorado Springs and ship reliably to the Florence area.

Fremont County community

Custom apparel for Florence's businesses, correctional staff, healthcare workers, and community events.

Florence schools

Spirit wear and team uniforms for Florence Junior/Senior High School athletics.

Ship to your door

We handle your order from Colorado Springs and ship directly to Florence — no commute required.
